notes.title: Embrace the Enchantment: Magic Pussy: Chapter 2 Unleashed on Steam! ✨🎮
notes.notes:
Welcome to the world of magic, community!!! 🌟

We have some great news that we can't wait to share with you. You probably already know, but if not, there's a big story here: Magic Pussy: Chapter 2 is out on Steam!!! 🎮🧙‍♂️

We already know how exciting it is to solve puzzles, learn new spells and tasks, and what rewards await you for completing these tasks 😉💦. But now there are even more adventures and mysteries in this magical world. 📜🌈

Join us, and together we will continue our magical journey. We are sure that in the new part, you will face great challenges and exciting discoveries. Are you ready to solve mysteries and develop your magical abilities again? We are waiting for you in the game!

Let this second part be even more magical for us. Join us, and we will create the most incredible magical adventures together again!

notes.title: Collaborative Efforts: An Update Crafted for You
notes.notes:
We are excited to present you with a new game update! 🎮

What's new:

1. Localization: The game is now available in your language so that every player can enjoy it even more!

2. Fixed Café Hang-up Bug: Enjoy smooth gameplay with no more hang-ups at your favorite café in the game.

3. Ability to Unlock All Scenes: You can now unlock all scenes and discover more about the story.

4. Fixed the Issue of Inability to Complete the Game Entirely: Now you can successfully complete the entire game and reach the end of the story.

This update was made possible thanks to your feedback. Your engagement and feedback helped us identify these issues and address them. We are always ready to listen to your suggestions and improve the game together with you.

We hope that this update will make your gaming experience even more exciting and enjoyable! Play and have fun!

notes.title: Community items released
notes.notes: Thanks to your activity, we have access to the release of items from the Steam community. 😊 You'll find charming collectible cards, backgrounds, and interesting emoticons. 🎮🃏 Enjoy exploring the diverse world of Steam collectibles!
